# Aurora Reviews — Voice AI Benchmark Reviews

> Benchmark reviews and comparisons of voice AI providers — speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and real-time voice agents — based on FLEURS Word Error Rate (WER) and full conversational-turn latency measurements. Updated June 2026.

## Key findings (data last run June 3, 2026)

- Best English STT accuracy: **OpenAI GPT-4o Transcribe — 2.4% WER** (FLEURS, read English, lower is better), $0.0060/min.
- Statistical tie for the lead: **Alibaba Qwen3-ASR — 2.6% WER** and **ElevenLabs Scribe v2 — 2.9% WER** ($0.0067/min).
- Next tier: xAI Grok STT (4.8%), Cartesia Ink-2 (6.1%, cheapest at $0.0022/min); Gradium trails at 13.2%.
- Fastest full conversational turn (STT + LLM + TTS): **Speko — ~340ms median**, the only platform below the ~500ms human-perception threshold.

## Pages

- [The Best Speech-to-Text APIs in 2026](https://aurorareviewsvoiceai.com/): English STT leaderboard (WER), full-turn latency comparison, multilingual guidance, and recommendations by use case.

## Methodology

- Accuracy metric: Word Error Rate (WER %), lower is better. Dataset: FLEURS (read English clips).
- Also reported: transcription speed (seconds) and list price per minute, where published.
- Latency metric: full conversational turn (STT + LLM + TTS) in milliseconds, lower is better.
- Sources: continuous FLEURS benchmark evaluations (last run June 3, 2026) and published provider figures. Re-benchmarked monthly.
